items.title: 华尔街带着战争即将结束的希望高歌猛进进入6月。未来展望
items.snippet: 下周股市展望：2026年6月1日至5日 跳过导航 市场 商业 投资 科技 政治 视频 关注列表 投资俱乐部 PRO 直播 菜单 股市持续押注伊朗战争将达成某种解决方案，但进入新月份之际，风险依然层出不穷。股市在5月收盘时创下历史新高，延续了自3月低点以来的反弹势头，市场对霍尔木兹海峡即将重新开放的信心不断增强。本周，随着债券收益率下降、油价回落，以及主要股指因特朗普政府接近达成和平协议而上涨，市场初步展现了解决方案可能带来的反应。纳斯达克综合指数自4月底以来上涨超过8%。特朗普总统的核要求仍是任何协议的关键障碍。周五，总统表示伊朗“必须同意永远不拥有核武器”，并称他正在战情室开会，以做出“最终决定”。但美伊战争的不受欢迎以及加油站汽油价格上涨，尤其是在关键的期中选举年，让投资者相信冲突将很快结束。“从全球经济角度看，最重要的是让霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，而我们将核问题暂时搁置，”Wayve Capital Management投资主管里斯·威廉姆斯表示。“我认为这就是目前可能达成的协议。”
items.snippetEN: Stock market next week: Outlook for June 1-5, 2026 Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu The stock market continues to bet on some sort of a resolution to the war with Iran, but there are no shortages of other risks heading into a new month. Stocks ended the month of May at all-time highs, continuing their rebound off the March lows on growing confidence that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen soon. This week gave some hint into what a response to a resolution would be like, as bond yields declined, oil prices retreated and the major stock averages rallied on hopes the Trump administration is nearing a peace deal. The Nasdaq Composite was up more than 8% since the end of April. President Trump's nuclear demands remain a key sticking point for any agreement. On Friday, the president said that Iran "must agree that they will never have a Nuclear Weapon," and said he was convening in the Situation Room to deliberate a "final determination." But the unpopularity of the U.S.-Iran war and higher gasoline prices at the pump, especially in a critical midterm election year, have investors confident the conflict will soon wrap up. "The most important thing is to get the Strait of Hormuz open, from a world economy point of view, and we kick the can down the road on nuclear," said Rhys Williams, investment chief at Wayve Capital Management. "That's the deal that I think is out there.
